recognize_zh: CD10 染色中，密集的中等大小淋巴瘤細胞大多為陰性，只有散在細胞呈強陽性；這提醒你高分級濾泡性淋巴瘤（grade 3）可失去 CD10 表現，不能因 CD10 陰性就排除 FL。
features: Dense population of medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei, largely CD10-negative
Scattered individual cells with strong membranous/cytoplasmic CD10 staining, more numerous at the right of the field
Weak, granular background staining between cells without a crisp membranous pattern in the tumor cells
No discrete CD10-positive follicle-center pattern delineated in this field
describe_en: CD10 immunohistochemistry shows a sheet of medium-sized lymphoid cells that are predominantly negative, with only faint background staining. Scattered cells, clustered toward one side of the field, show strong CD10 positivity; these may represent residual germinal-center cells or granulocytes and do not account for the bulk of the infiltrate. The neoplastic population therefore appears largely CD10-negative in this field. Loss or reduction of CD10 is recognized in grade 3 follicular lymphoma, particularly grade 3B, and interpretation should be integrated with BCL6, BCL2 and the H&E findings.

ddx.vs: MZL is also CD10-negative but lacks BCL6 expression and centroblast-rich follicular nodules, and shows monocytoid morphology.
Reactive germinal centers are uniformly CD10-positive and sharply confined to follicles with BCL2-negative germinal centers.
Low-grade FL is typically diffusely CD10-positive within neoplastic follicles, whereas CD10 loss favors higher grade.
